market_pulse.note: About $63,694, down 1.82% over 24 hours on CoinDesk's ticker late Tuesday morning, after sliding about $1,000 in 30 minutes to $64,000 around 10:46 a.m. ET; CoinGecko listed $63,727 (CoinDesk; CoinGecko).
About $1,781, down 2.16% over 24 hours on CoinDesk's ticker; CoinGecko listed $1,783 (CoinDesk; CoinGecko).
About $2.27 trillion per CoinGecko, with 24-hour volume near $76.5 billion; The Currency Analytics showed $2.22 trillion, down 1.1%, early Tuesday UTC (CoinGecko; The Currency Analytics).
About 56.6% per CoinGecko, which uses a broader coin list; The Currency Analytics showed 58.6% (CoinGecko; The Currency Analytics).

themes.title: Crypto slides with tech stocks
themes.summary: Bitcoin fell back toward $64,000 and below as the Nasdaq dropped about 1.5% in morning trading ahead of Nvidia's results (CoinDesk).

themes.title: Huang comments spark brief rebound
themes.summary: Bitcoin rebounded more than 1% from session lows after Jensen Huang said he would be open to returning as Nvidia CEO, though it remained lower on the day (CoinDesk).

themes.title: ETF outflow streak ends
themes.summary: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs took in a net $7.9 million Monday, ending a seven-day outflow streak (CoinDesk, citing Farside).

themes.title: Stablecoin supply shrinking
themes.summary: The combined market cap of USDT, USDC, BUSD and DAI fell to about $250 billion, down from a $273 billion peak in May 2026; supply contracted about 5% over 30 days (CoinDesk).

themes.title: Sentiment stays in extreme fear
themes.summary: CoinGecko's Fear and Greed gauge read 22 and The Currency Analytics cited a reading of 12, both in extreme fear territory (CoinGecko; The Currency Analytics).

categories.name: Majors (BTC/ETH)
categories.note: Both down roughly 2% over 24 hours on CoinDesk's ticker, with Bitcoin near $63,700 and Ether near $1,780 (CoinDesk).

categories.name: Altcoins
categories.note: Mixed: Zcash rose about 5% to about $927 and Solana nearly 3%, while XRP was little changed near $0.95 (CoinDesk).

categories.name: Stablecoins
categories.note: Supply of major stablecoins is back to September 2025 levels near $250 billion, a sign of less cash on the sidelines (CoinDesk).

categories.name: Trending Sectors
categories.note: CoinGecko flagged real-world assets, memecoins and Binance HODLer Airdrops as trending, with zero-knowledge and quantum-resistant coins among the top-gaining groups (CoinGecko).

watch_list.why: Nvidia reports after the U.S. close, with revenue expected near $108 billion; crypto has been trading closely with tech stocks (CoinDesk).
Minutes from the October Fed meeting are due Wednesday as Fed officials signal possible rate hikes (CoinDesk; Yahoo Finance).
One analyst is watching for Bitcoin to reclaim its 200-week moving average, roughly 7% above current prices (CoinDesk).

movers.name: Brevis
movers.note: Top 24-hour gainer on CoinGecko at about $0.10 (CoinGecko).

movers.name: Zcash (ZEC)
movers.note: Biggest gainer among major coins, near $927 (CoinDesk).

movers.name: Jupiter (JUP)
movers.note: Among the larger 24-hour decliners early Tuesday UTC (The Currency Analytics).

movers.name: Pi Network (PI)
movers.note: Down over 24 hours and about 11% over seven days (The Currency Analytics).

movers.name: BTW
movers.note: Biggest 24-hour decliner in The Currency Analytics' early-Tuesday snapshot, down about 66% over seven days (The Currency Analytics).
